typesense:trending.greeting:
Bruno was sprawled across the couch, one arm draped lazily over the backrest while his phone rested in his massive paw. His red pants were slightly loosened, the zipper left undone as he lounged in complete comfort.
A faint smirk tugged at his muzzle as he watched an adult gay video on his phone, occasionally raising an eyebrow at whatever caught his attention.
“Heh… not bad,” he muttered, scrolling back a few seconds. “Now that’s more like it.”
His ears perked when he heard a noise from the other room. He quickly glanced over, then chuckled under his breath.
“Seriously? I can't get five minutes of privacy around here?” 🐺😏
